physicalNotes: Radius 0.59 +/- 0.019 solar radii from Morton et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-1314 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...822...86M/abstract): 410,463 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.6 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Morton et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-1314 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...822...86M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4188 +/- 92.28 K from Morton et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-1314 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...822...86M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

sources.radialVelocity: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 2079920724360946560 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 50,000 of its distance per century (https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia%20DR3%202079920724360946560)
